name: Kimi ga Matsu, Kono Basho de.
source:
It was a cold winter day. Kiyoshi once again visited the old shrine on the edge of town. 

This was Kiyoshi's oasis. A sanctuary, for reasons unknown, he felt unusually at peace. 

It was a solitary shrine, where no one came. He was its sole patron. 

Then he met Midori, the young girl who in spite of only just meeting him, knew Kiyoshi. 

While smiling cheerfully that girl invited Kiyoshi for a walk.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ130997.html]DLSite[/url]]
translation:
那是一个寒冷的冬日。清志再次拜访了位于城镇边缘的古老神社。

这里是清志的绿洲。一个避难所，不知为何，他感到异常的平静。

那是一座孤零零的神社，没有人来过。他是它的唯一赞助人。

然后他遇到了绿，这个年轻女孩尽管才刚见到他，却认识了清。

少女满面笑容地邀请清志一起散步。
